name: Shinbi
source:
Shinbi is Eri's other best friend, who works as a model. Shinbi has fangirls at the academy due to her androgynous looks and tall height.

Though she may look absent-minded, she is quite serious and very thoughtful of Eri.

Likes: Strawberry milk
Dislikes: Rumours, troublesome things

[Edited From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
